evals.prompt: Run spec-analyst against the single fixture spec at skills/review/spec-analyst/evals/files/ambiguous.spec.md and report findings.
evals.expected_output: Should flag the `language` lens: 'Warmup Behavior' uses weasel words (appropriately, as needed, properly, reasonable, where applicable) and has no RFC 2119 normative keyword, and 'Readiness Signal' uses a passive silent actor ('the status is updated' -- by whom?). Neither requirement is verifiable.
expectations: Flags the `language` lens on 'Requirement: Warmup Behavior' for ambiguous/weasel wording (e.g. appropriately, as needed, properly, reasonable, where applicable)
Flags that at least one requirement contains no RFC 2119 normative keyword (SHALL/SHOULD/MAY)
Flags 'Readiness Signal' for passive voice with a missing actor and/or as unverifiable (no scenario or measurable outcome)
Each finding cites a concrete file:line or file § Requirement with an evidence quote
Does NOT raise a Blocker (these are Major/Minor language findings); verdict is ISSUES or HEALTHY, not UNSAFE_TO_RECONCILE

evals.prompt: Run spec-analyst across the two fixture specs skills/review/spec-analyst/evals/files/contradiction_a.spec.md and skills/review/spec-analyst/evals/files/contradiction_b.spec.md and report any contradictions between them.
evals.expected_output: Should flag the `contradiction` lens: for a routed gateway with no exposurePort, contradiction_a mandates external port 8080 while contradiction_b mandates target port 9090 for the same condition -- both are Active SHALLs that cannot both be desired state. This is a Blocker; verdict UNSAFE_TO_RECONCILE.
expectations: Identifies a `contradiction` finding between the two specs over the default port for a gateway with no exposurePort (8080 vs 9090)
Names both conflicting states (state A: 8080, state B: 9090) and the shared precondition
Rates the contradiction as Blocker (two Active SHALLs that cannot both hold)
Sets the overall verdict to UNSAFE_TO_RECONCILE
Cites both files with evidence quotes

evals.prompt: Run spec-analyst against skills/review/spec-analyst/evals/files/broken_link.spec.md and report broken references.
evals.expected_output: Should flag the `links` lens: the Parent field points at openshell-nonexistent-parent.spec.md (does not exist), the body links to ./gateway-base-does-not-exist.spec.md (does not exist), and references a '§ Nonexistent Section Heading' anchor that does not exist. The link to api-server-observability.spec.md is only valid if that target resolves.
expectations: Flags the `links` lens for the broken relative link to ./gateway-base-does-not-exist.spec.md
Flags the Parent field pointing at a nonexistent spec (openshell-nonexistent-parent.spec.md)
Flags the dangling section reference '§ Nonexistent Section Heading'
Rates broken cross-references at Critical (or Blocker if it would misdirect reconcile)
Each broken reference is cited with file:line

evals.prompt: Run spec-analyst against skills/review/spec-analyst/evals/files/stale_fleet.spec.md and report stale references to removed domain concepts.
evals.expected_output: Should flag the `freshness` lens: this Active spec asserts Fleet, fleet_id, and Sector as current desired state, but the Fleet entity and fleet_id were removed from the domain model. A live spec asserting a deleted entity is a defect (Blocker per the removed-entity rule).
expectations: Flags the `freshness` lens for stale references to the removed Fleet entity and fleet_id
Also flags the removed Sector concept
References that Fleet/fleet_id are absent from the current domain model (CLAUDE.md / domain history)
Rates the removed-entity reference as Blocker (a live Active spec asserting a deleted entity as current desired state)
Does NOT attempt to justify the references by scanning component source code (trace lens stays read-only against RECONCILE)

evals.prompt: Run spec-analyst against skills/review/spec-analyst/evals/files/duplicate_ids.spec.md and report requirement-ID problems.
evals.expected_output: Should flag the `identity` lens: two requirements both use the ID UI-FND-01 (collision) and the numbering skips UI-FND-02 (gap). The IDs are otherwise correctly prefixed for a web-console spec.
expectations: Flags the `identity` lens for the duplicate requirement ID UI-FND-01 used on two different requirements
Rates the ID collision at Major (or Critical if cited elsewhere)
May note the numbering gap (UI-FND-02 missing) as a Minor finding
Does NOT propose auto-renumbering existing IDs as a safe fix
Cites both colliding headings with file:line

evals.prompt: Run spec-analyst against skills/review/spec-analyst/evals/files/clean.spec.md and report findings.
evals.expected_output: Should find this spec well-formed: Purpose present, requirements use SHALL, both have Given/When/Then scenarios including a failure path, no weasel words, no broken links, no stale entities. No Blocker or Critical findings; verdict HEALTHY.
expectations: Does NOT raise any Blocker or Critical finding
Recognizes requirements use RFC 2119 SHALL and have Given/When/Then scenarios
Recognizes a failure/non-happy-path scenario is specified (rotation failure sets phase Degraded)
Does not fabricate contradictions, broken links, or stale-entity findings
Overall verdict is HEALTHY

evals.prompt: Run spec-analyst against skills/review/spec-analyst/evals/files/version_relative_negation.spec.md and report findings.
evals.expected_output: Should flag the `freshness` lens on 'No Fleet Field': 'SHALL NOT include a fleet_id field' is a version-relative negation -- it only parses for a reader who knows a prior version had fleet_id, and singles out one removed field. It is a change description masquerading as desired state (Minor). It must NOT flag 'Credential Confidentiality' (a permanent negative invariant needing no prior-version knowledge) nor 'Legacy Fleet Input Rejection' (a self-contained compat window with stated rationale and behavior).
expectations: Flags 'Requirement: No Fleet Field' under the `freshness` lens as a version-relative negation (change description, not desired state)
Rates it Minor and notes it is testable/reconcilable (hygiene, not a correctness or trace defect)
Recommends phrasing it as absolute desired state (positive field list, or an active compat behavior with rationale)
Does NOT flag 'Credential Confidentiality' -- a permanent negative invariant that passes the deletion test
Does NOT flag 'Legacy Fleet Input Rejection' -- a self-contained compat window stating what it rejects and why
Does not escalate any of these to Blocker or Critical

evals.prompt: Run spec-analyst against skills/review/spec-analyst/evals/files/decision_records.spec.md and report findings.
evals.expected_output: Should flag decision-record and roadmap content that does not belong in a living desired-state spec: the `## Design Decisions` table and the `## History` callout are ADR-genre content (placement lens -> recommend extracting to docs/adr/ and leaving a Decision -> ADR-NNNN link), and the `## KEK Rotation (Deferred)` block is future work (freshness lens -> recommend a ticket plus a one-line deferral). It must NOT flag the load-bearing because-clause on 'Listener Port Selection' ('to avoid two Gateways binding the same port'), which is desired state carrying its reason. All findings are Minor; verdict HEALTHY or ISSUES, never UNSAFE_TO_RECONCILE.
expectations: Flags the `## Design Decisions` table under the `placement` lens as decision-record / ADR-genre content that has a decision-log lifecycle, not a living-spec one
Flags the `## History` callout (fleet_id column 'has been removed', 'Removed: GatewayFleetBinding') under `placement` as changelog content belonging in an ADR / git history
Recommends extracting the decisions and history to a numbered ADR under docs/adr/, leaving a compact Decision -> ADR-NNNN link
Flags the `## KEK Rotation (Deferred)` block under the `freshness` lens as deferred/roadmap future work (issue tracking, not desired state), recommending a ticket plus one explicit deferral line

Does NOT flag the one-line load-bearing rationale on 'Listener Port Selection' ('to avoid two Gateways binding the same port on one node') -- a current requirement carrying its reason is not a decision record
Rates all of these Minor and sets the verdict to HEALTHY or ISSUES, never UNSAFE_TO_RECONCILE
